Set keys in the config file. KEY= removes a key. With --stdin, reads one JSON object
{"KEY": "value"} from stdin instead, so secrets never show up in the process list.

Usage:
  lobo config set KEY=value... [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help    help for set
      --stdin   read {"KEY": "value"} JSON from stdin (keeps secrets out of argv)

Global Flags:
      --config string   config file (dotenv; the OS env is never read) (default "/home/u/.config/lobo/config.env")
